criteria.name: Identical source event replay is deduplicated; changed payload under the same session/event ID is rejected
Counters are monotonic within immutable model segments; an explicit baseline or new segment is required for reset accounting
Unknown opening balances remain unknown while later known increments can be reported
Capacity caps must be positive and exhaustion returns an explicit error without eviction
Cache read/write categories remain separate and large values have decimal-string accessors
Standalone module compiles with warnings denied and all inline tests pass
evidence: rustc standalone test run: 7 passed, 0 failed

decisions: Event identity is scoped to a session and source_event_id.
A missing cumulative reading leaves the last known cumulative value unchanged and never contributes zero usage.
A left-censored opening balance keeps the full segment total unknown, even when later increments are known.
The overflow unit test directly exercises the checked-add boundary because valid monotone u64 observations cannot overflow their own cumulative counter.
limitations: The module is not wired into providers/mod.rs or lib.rs because shared wiring is outside this packet's scope.
The accumulator is in-memory; persistence, provider event parsing, and retention lifecycle belong to integration/runtime owners.
The module was validated with a standalone rustc test harness rather than Cargo because no module registration is permitted in this packet.
next_action: Integrator review and wiring; treat this as prototype evidence, not acceptance.
